REPAIRS_CONFIRMED: Duplicate JSON member names are rejected after escape decoding at all nesting depths.
Unpaired surrogate escapes, UTF-8 BOM behavior, Markdown LF/CRLF/bare-CR behavior, media-type derivation, Unicode NFC profile, and identifier boundary-whitespace set are explicitly pinned.
Validation diagnostic detail_hash free-form text ambiguity is removed by a typed RFC8785/JCS diagnostic object.
External Locator V4 binds the exact Universe V4 blob and remains resolution-only.
All three published validation-diagnostic hash vectors independently recompute exactly to their expected SHA-256 values.

VECTOR_RECOMPUTATION.canonicalization: sorted-key RFC8785-compatible JCS for the ASCII vector objects

BLOCKING_FINDINGS.ISSUE: JSON TYPE/SEVERITY/STATUS are extracted as exact top-level values or null when absent, while normalized_finding_row permits only JSON string or null. V4 defines a non-string rejection rule for FINDING_ID but no exact disposition/error for present non-string TYPE, SEVERITY or STATUS.
BLOCKING_FINDINGS.COUNTEREXAMPLE: A valid JSON object with FINDING_ID='F-A' and SEVERITY=0 parses successfully. One implementation can reject it as PARSE_ERROR while another can carry numeric SEVERITY_RAW until row validation; V4 does not choose one authoritative outcome.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define exact allowed JSON type for each authority-bearing field before normalized-row creation.
Present non-string TYPE/SEVERITY/STATUS must have one exact fail-closed disposition/conflict code, with test vectors.

BLOCKING_FINDINGS.ISSUE: V4 fixes detail_hash bytes but still does not define a closed validation error-code registry, exact condition-to-error-row mapping/multiplicity, or a normative derivation of blocking_error_count from errors. validation_summary.complete can be evaluated without requiring errors=[] under the written rule.
BLOCKING_FINDINGS.COUNTEREXAMPLE: Two implementations can detect the same invalid condition, emit different nonempty code strings or different numbers of error rows, keep the same other counts, and produce different COMPLETE_FINDING_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH values. The test-vector expected codes do not themselves define the contract-wide mapping.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define a versioned closed error-code registry and exact one-condition-to-row generation rules.
Define blocking_error_count mechanically from error rows or typed blocking dispositions.
Require complete=true to imply the exact allowed error-row state, preferably errors=[] and blocking_error_count=0.

BLOCKING_FINDINGS.ISSUE: AUTHORITY_REFERENCE_POINTER_REGISTRY defines JSON pointers for BOOTSTRAP_SCHEMA, and authority_reference_row contains authority_path/blob, but V4 never defines the complete snapshot-bound set of authority documents to which those pointers must be applied. No BOOTSTRAP_FENCE_STATE path/source-root is named.
BLOCKING_FINDINGS.COUNTEREXAMPLE: Generator A evaluates the active target's Bootstrap Fence while generator B evaluates no authority document. Both can claim every pointer in their chosen input set was evaluated, yet authority_reference_rows and finding reachability differ.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define the exact authority-source denominator: canonical path(s), schema/version selection, target-key binding and same-snapshot blob identities.
Account every authority source exactly once and fail closed on missing/duplicate/unknown active authority schema.
Bind the authority-source denominator/root into COMPLETE_FINDING_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH.

NONBLOCKING_VECTOR_NOTE.ISSUE: Markdown vectors use encoded_escape_notation=true with backslash escape text but do not define the decoder from notation to candidate bytes. This does not by itself alter the V4 contract, but it weakens portable executable conformance evidence.
NONBLOCKING_VECTOR_NOTE.RECOMMENDATION: Publish exact UTF-8 hex/base64 bytes or a versioned escape-decoding algorithm for every byte-sensitive vector.
